name: ambicode
description: AMBICODE Claude Code plugin helpers: scoped policy, evidence checks, independent review, human-selected publication.

scripts.evals:walk: npm run evals:select && npm run evals:run -- --tag walk --runs 1 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 2 -j 4 --walk
scripts.evals:walk:haiku: npm run evals:select && npm run evals:run -- --tag walk --runs 1 --ablation none --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --max-cost-usd 2 -j 4 --walk
scripts.evals:baseline: npm run evals:select && node evals/cases/scripts/src/arms/naked-arm.mjs && npm run evals:bench -- run --plugin .tmp/naked --trust-plugin --runs 3 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 15 -j 4
scripts.evals:decide: npm run evals:select && npm run evals:run -- --runs 3 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 20 -j 4
scripts.evals:full: npm run evals:generate && npm run evals:bench -- run --set full --project BE-express --runs 1 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 22.5 -j 4 && npm run evals:bench -- run --set full --project FE-angular --runs 1 --ablation none --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 22.5 -j 4
scripts.evals:archived: npm run evals:preflight && d=$(node evals/cases/scripts/src/harness/iteration-dir.mjs archived typescript-sonnet-5-5) && npm run evals:plugin-eval -- --eval-dir evals/cases/common/archived/typescript --runs 3 --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --ablation with-without -j 4 --max-cost-usd 10 --allow-tools Bash 'WebFetch(domain:api.anthropic.com)' --json "$d/results/eval.json" --output-dir "$d/results/plugin-eval"
scripts.evals:triggers: d=$(node evals/cases/scripts/src/harness/iteration-dir.mjs triggers sonnet-5-5) || exit 1; npm run evals:plugin-eval -- --eval-dir evals/cases/common/triggers --runs 1 --model claude-sonnet-5-5 -j 4 --ablation none --max-cost-usd 4 --allow-tools Bash --json "$d/results/eval.json" --output-dir "$d/results/plugin-eval"; s=$?; node evals/cases/scripts/src/harness/run-validity.mjs "$d/results/eval.json" && exit $s
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run validate:plugin
